Update the existing target while preserving omitted fields.

Usage: provenance [OPTIONS] <TARGET> [ACTION]

Arguments:
  <TARGET>  
  [ACTION]  [possible values: get, trace, create, update, answer, claim, release, submit, discussions, discussion, discuss, reply]

Options:
      --repo <REPO>
          [default: .]
      --scope <SCOPE>
          [default: default]
      --format <FORMAT>
          [possible values: json]
      --quiet
          
      --stdin
          
      --replace-parent <REPLACE_PARENT>
          Replace this Requirement parent and preserve its other parents
      --with-parent <WITH_PARENT>
          Add this parent before the selected parent is removed
      --commit-pin <commit-pin>
          
      --name <name>
          
      --reference <reference>
          
      --source-type <source-type>
          
      --supersedes <supersedes>
          
      --url <url>
          
      --actor <actor>
          
      --depends-on <depends-on>
          
      --description <description>
          
      --statement <statement>
          
      --status <status>
          
      --approved-at <approved-at>
          
      --approved-by <approved-by>
          
      --context <context>
          
      --inputs <inputs>
          
      --made-by <made-by>
          
      --position <position>
          
      --rationale <rationale>
          
      --requirement-ids <requirement-ids>
          
      --title <title>
          
      --archived-in-commit <archived-in-commit>
          
      --resolution-ids <resolution-ids>
          
      --severity <severity>
          
      --source-document <source-document>
          
      --source-section <source-section>
          
      --resolution-id <resolution-id>
          
      --links <links>
          
      --contradicts <contradicts>
          
      --question <question>
          
      --resolution-method <resolution-method>
          
      --if-match <if-match>
          
      --declared-by <declared-by>
          
      --relationships <relationships>
          
      --actor-json <actor-json>
          
      --approved-at-json <approved-at-json>
          
      --approved-by-json <approved-by-json>
          
      --archived-in-commit-json <archived-in-commit-json>

      --context-json <context-json>
          
      --contradicts-json <contradicts-json>
